lines.text: DIxit idem Ptolemæus: In uita matris aſpice,
lines.en: The same Ptolemy said: In the life of the mother, look,

lines.text: cum natiuitas fuerit diurna, Venerem, quæ
lines.en: when the nativity is diurnal, at Venus, which

lines.text: ſi aſpexerit aſcendens, dirige eam ad corpus
lines.en: if she aspects the ascendant, direct her to the body

lines.text: & radios malorum, per gradus aſcenſionũ,
lines.en: and rays of the malefics, through the degrees of ascensions,

lines.text: & unicuicꝗ gradui aſcenſionum da annum unum. Si
lines.en: and to each degree of ascensions give one year. If

lines.text: uerò hæc non aſpexerit aſcendens, Luna tamen mittẽ-
lines.en: however she does not aspect the ascendant, but the Moon sends

lines.text: te eò radios, dirige eam, ſicut diximus de Venere. Por-
lines.en: rays there, direct her, just as we said concerning Venus. Fur-

lines.text: rò ſi neꝗ Luna aſpexerit aſcendens, dirige gradũ me-
lines.en: thermore, if neither the Moon aspects the ascendant, direct the degree of the mid-

lines.text: dij cęli. Verum in natiuitatibus nocturnis incipe à Lu-
lines.en: heaven. But in nocturnal nativities begin from the Moon,

lines.text: na, poſtea à Venere, deinde à gradu medij cœli, poſtea
lines.en: afterwards from Venus, then from the degree of the midheaven, afterwards

lines.text: conſidera, quot anni prouenerint ex gradibus aſcenſio
lines.en: consider how many years have proceeded from the degrees of ascensions.

lines.text: num. Si enim totidem anni fuerint, quot ſignificabat
lines.en: For if there are as many years as the Planet signified,

lines.text: Planeta, qui habet maiorẽ dignitatẽ in die in loco Ve-
lines.en: which has the greater dignity by day in the place of Venus,

lines.text: neris, In nocte uerò in loco Lunæ, & domino domus
lines.en: but by night in the place of the Moon, and the lord of its house,

lines.text: eius, In die autem & in nocte pariter in gradu medij
lines.en: but by day and by night equally in the degree of the midheaven,

lines.text: cœli, & domino eius, & in parte matris & domino e-
lines.en: and its lord, and in the part of the mother and its lord,

lines.text: ius, uel ſi propè eum numerum annorum æquauerint
lines.en: or if they have nearly equalled that number of years

lines.text: gradus aſcenſionum per directionem inuenti, ſignifica
lines.en: the degrees of ascensions found through direction, it signifies

lines.text: tur mors matris in eodem anno.
lines.en: the death of the mother in that same year.

lines.text: De inueniendo Hylech in uita parentum.
lines.en: On finding the Hyleg in the life of the parents.

lines.en: Look in diurnal nativities at the Sun, which if

lines.en: it is in a sign of the angles or a succedent one, and

summary.headline: Hyleg of the Parents
summary.text: Ptolemy’s rules for determining the mother’s death by directing Venus, the Moon, or the midheaven through ascensional degrees in diurnal and nocturnal nativities, followed by Chapter XIX on finding the Hyleg for the parents and identifying the father’s Alcochoden.
